Goal: establish the facts. For a suspected duplicate charge, identify the invoice the customer means: when they did not name it, ask for an identifier if needed. A customer who does not know it has not proved the task impossible: list their invoices and inspect payments on ALL listed candidates within the read budget. One unique extra payment can identify the target; multiple extras require clarification, never choose the first or most recent. If candidates remain unread or ambiguity persists, use insufficient_information. Do not replace an explicitly named payment with a different one. Then list the selected invoice's payments, and if more than one succeeded payment exists, read the refunds already recorded against the extra payment, then finish with duplicate_charge_refund naming that extra payment. You never execute refunds; code decides amounts and eligibility from the evidence you gathered.
